blurb: Guests can enjoy craft beers brewed on site, pizzas made with house-fermented dough, salads, and small plates focusing on farm-to-table ingredients. The brewery offers indoor and outdoor seating including a large beer garden. They host live music, taproom events, and private parties including weddings and corporate events.
